title: Wringer loop manifest
description: manifest.json of a `wring run` loop bundle — the index of one repair loop. Schema version wringer.loop.v2, versioned independently of the evidence bundle (wringer.evidence.v1) that each iteration writes. **v2, and v1 is still published and still frozen** — the untracked-v2 precedent. v1 froze `result.reason` as a CLOSED enum of six values, so a seventh way for the loop to stop was unrepresentable: `flaky_gate` (SPEC_STABILITY_V0 §4) is a stop where NO worker ran, and none of the six is nearly true of it — the tree is not unchanged, the same failure did not come back, and re-verifying would give a DIFFERENT answer. v2's `reason` is therefore an open string with its known values in the description. That is a deliberate design change: the fleet's own manifest and events have always recorded `reason` as a plain string, and closed here every future stop reason costs a version — version churn on the bundle format is what a frozen schema exists to prevent, not cause. A v1 bundle stays readable by everything that read one before; `loop.SCHEMA_VERSIONS` is the derived list every reader accepts.

loop_id.description: The loop directory's name, YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<4 hex>.

started_at.description: Local time with UTC offset, seconds precision.

repo.description: The tree as it was when the loop started — not after it ran.

config.description: What the loop was told to do, redacted.

max_iterations.description: The budget actually used, after any --max-iterations override.

worker.description: The declared worker command, before placeholder substitution.

status.description: converged = the gates passed. stopped = they did not. interrupted = Ctrl-C.

reason.description: Why it ended, as a free string. The values the shipped loop emits are `converged`, `max_iterations`, `no_progress` (the worker left the tree byte-identical), `oscillating` (it changed something but the same failure shape returned), `budget_exhausted` (the wall_clock ran out), `flaky_gate` (the failing gate did not give the same answer twice on one tree, so no worker was called at all — an agent briefed with it would edit source that was never wrong) and `interrupted`. Open rather than enumerated ON PURPOSE, so a new stop reason never costs a bundle-format version; the drift guard is `test_the_console_names_every_reason_the_loop_can_stop_for`, which pins `loop._REASONS`, `cli._LOOP_ENDINGS` and `graph.LOOP_REASONS` against each other and has already caught this class of gap once.

iterations.description: How many verifications ran, including the one that converged.

final_run.description: Repo-relative path of the last evidence bundle, or null if no verification completed.
